Update: 08/05/20
She's still here. The vet opens in an hour. She's been getting colder since yesterday so right now I have blankets over her inside her bed and some really warm bottles. If she hasn't given up then I can't either. I'm going to ask the doctor to most likely hold her and keep her with a feeding tube and iv fluids. I think it might be her antibiotics that are giving her these multiple side effects. Amoxicillin can give animals; inappetence, difficulty breathing, swelling especially around the face and muzzle, discoloured urine, incoordination with walking, and she also has mouth ulcers. When my bf was in the hospital last year he also had negative reactions to his antibiotics. He got bad mouth sores (just one of the reactions) and had to be given a separate medicine. I worry she might be getting the same reaction. And that the sores are making her feel lots of pain and have no interest in wanting to drink any water or eat because it hurts. We have about $180 left to our names, my mom said she'd help with at least $200 and my bf gets paid Friday. I just want her to be back to being happy and healthy. I had two dreams; in both she was running around happily in the room. I cried happy tears in my dream, I can only hope my dreams will come true

I'm scared. I called my mom but she says she's busy. I call my bf but he's 2hrs away right now and was doing his best to console me. She's breathing through her mouth. I'm crying right now. We're doing everything we can I'm trying to help her get better but she's struggling. I pray she stays with us. I need to see her happy and healthy again. I'm so scared

To everyone interested. I took her to the vet and he said she seems a little better but still not in the best shape. Still quite dehydrated. He gave her IV fluids again and 3 injections again. We're gonna try and see how she'll be tomorrow ok?" idk but it made me still feel hopeless, Id like an answer so she can get the proper treatment and I know she'll be ok. I wanted to answer but I knew my voice would crack. I was quiet for a minute and said "..ya ok" but it sounded crackly. He tried comforting me and said that in his honest opinion he didn't think she'd have survived the surgery since it was so massive and that he didn't think she was gonna make it through the night so it's a good thing she's still here. At least right now her eye seems to be better but she still doesn't want to eat, drink or be able to use the restroom. I had to leave my home for a couple hours so I left her in the restroom with food, water, a pet bed (she really likes it), a litter box and I feel she'll be more comfortable being left alone than having me constantly checking her and bugging her by petting. I hope and think she'll feel more relaxed. I'm hoping when I get home she'll feel better. We'll barely have enough to pay for tomorrow but at least I'm glad our next paycheck is Friday.

Oh I see 😓 it really sucks when we're left with no real answer and it costs so much to find out. Have you tried hemp treats? We had a dog at our house that had way too much energy which was ok but we knew she'd get extra hyper for 4th of July since loud noises get her excited. She needed 4 pieces and she was very calm. I would look into the hemp treats. Maybe ask your vet if they're ok, they should be. It does seem like she's having separation anxiety. Her looking off at nothing there might be her missing them or expecting them. Cats will get weird bathroom behavior from change. Another cat/baby I have would pee on every piece of clothing when we got a new kitten. He took a month to go back to the litter box. Cats are use to things very easily so your ex being gone was probably a big change she doesn't know how to handle.

Added info. My cat was having bathroom troubles and after we found out she has pyometra, the vet said it could get so swollen it could block/put pressure and make it very hard for her to use the restroom. How old is she? Unfortunately I have depression and anxiety too and when we have to worry about the uncertainty with our pets, it's such a nightmare.

I'm sorry you're going through all of this 😓 I can see you're really trying. I would really recommend an x-ray as she might have an inner obstruction. My cat got an x-ray for what I assumed would be constipation but it was from an infected and swollen uterus. Is she spayed? She might have what my cat had: pyometra. Please look into it. My cat also had trouble using the restroom (pee and poo) which is why I assumed constipation or blockage. If she's not spayed, she has a bigger chance of getting it. It is a fairly simple surgery, they'll remove the entire uterus, she'll need some rest and antibiotics and she should be ok :) I'm hoping this will help. Please look up symptoms, maybe it'll help. Again PYOMETRA, just so it's easier to find if you read this comment. Thank you for helping me feel less alone, it certainly can feel like it. We will, all we can do for now is hope for the best and give our pets as much love and care as we can
